launcher.notes: First release. Checks the Wiki for pack updates, verifies the download by SHA-256, backs up your mods before applying an update, and can open the official Minecraft Launcher for you. Automatic self-update is not yet included in 1.0 — check the Wiki for new launcher versions manually.
